content.text: {"answer":"Monthly, within ten business days after the end of each calendar month (amended from quarterly, effective September 1, 2026), plus ad hoc meetings as needed.","source_document":"06_policy_update_memo.md","section":"Section 2.4 (Valuation Policy Section 2.3 (Meetings))","quote":"The Valuation Committee will meet monthly, within ten business days after the end of each calendar month, rather than quarterly, so that the Committee reviews Level 3 values, overrides and stale price reports within each monthly net asset value cycle. The first monthly meeting will address the September 30, 2026 month-end. The provisions for ad hoc meetings in Section 2.3, and the quorum and voting requirements in Section 2.2, are unchanged. This amendment supersedes Section 2.3 of the Valuation Policy."}
